# READY Core 30 — Complete Practice Audit Source

> **Generated from the runtime** by `npm run gen:practice-audit` (`scripts/generate-practice-audit.ts` → `apps/web/src/features/bootcamp/practiceAudit.ts`). Do not edit by hand: a test fails if this file differs from what the runtime renders.
>
> This is an inspection document. It records what the app currently contains; it does not recommend or change anything. Lines marked **AUTO-FLAG** are mechanical observations for a human reviewer, not verdicts.

## How to read this document

- "Sentence id" is written without its language prefix. In the app each language has its own copy (`en.…`, `fr.…`, `es.…`), so practice history is separate per learning language.
- EN / FR / ES are the three learning languages. HE is the Hebrew gloss shown to a Hebrew-interface learner; an English-interface learner sees the English gloss instead.
- Interface strings are quoted as "English" / "Hebrew".
- "Accepted" means the app treats the choice as correct. "Happy path" is the canonical conversation used by the transcript, Listen and the dialogue document.
- Question references (`M07-Q03`) number every interactive question of a mission in the order the learner meets it; the same references are used in the Question Bank at the end.

## What the auto-flags can and cannot see

Checked mechanically: identical answer choices; one sentence used as the audio of several questions; NPC questions on the happy path with no matching expected-reply sentence; expected-reply sentences whose wording no NPC line in the mission says; learner sentences that are never a selectable line or cold-open option; a line shown that differs from the sentence it is scored as; choice screens with no wrong option or a single button; answer choices first taught in another mission (teaching missions only); cold-open lines containing English words not met before; cold opens labelled "use a tool" without a tool among the options; gloss inconsistencies between languages.
NOT checked (needs a human): whether distractors are plausible, whether two differently worded choices mean the same, whether a translation is right, whether a dialogue feels natural. Word-level checks use English only.

Progression: no step blocks. A wrong answer never prevents continuing ("Continue" is always available next to "Try again"). There is no pass mark, no score threshold and no retry limit. Every step is required only in the sense that the flow is linear.

Not present in the runtime (so not exported): free sentence construction, typing, speech recognition, image questions, hints separate from tips, per-distractor explanations, per-choice feedback text. A dialogue screen with exactly one line is headed "Your turn — say your line" / "תורך — אמור את השורה שלך" instead of the choice heading.

## Audio / speech

- All mission audio goes through one function (`shared/audio/tts.ts`): asset-first playback with Web Speech (browser TTS) fallback. No prerecorded sentence assets are referenced by mission content, so in practice every line is browser TTS in the learning language's voice.
- One global speech-speed setting (Profile, 80–105 %, default 95 %) multiplies every utterance. On top of it the player uses fixed relative rates: NPC line 0.95 · NPC "fast" 1.08 · NPC "slow" 0.75 · the learner's chosen line 0.92 · cold open 1.12 (replay 0.85) · key-sentence replay after reveal 0.85.
- Every question screen has a replay button. Dialogue NPC lines advance automatically when the audio ends.
- Exceptions: none encoded per sentence. Mission videos are separate files (see each mission header).

## Global Recovery Toolkit

Not a mission. Eight phrases shared by all missions; a mission bundles the ones it uses. Selecting one in a dialogue is always accepted.

- `phrase.recovery.dont-understand` — EN "Sorry, I don't understand." · FR "Désolé, je ne comprends pas." · ES "Perdón, no entiendo." · HE "סליחה, אני לא מבין." — help tool — bundled in missions: 13, 14
- `phrase.recovery.repeat` — EN "Can you repeat that?" · FR "Vous pouvez répéter ?" · ES "¿Puede repetir, por favor?" · HE "אפשר לחזור על זה?" — help tool — bundled in missions: 01, 03, 05, 06, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 17, 18, 19, 20, 23, 26, 28, 29
- `phrase.recovery.slowly` — EN "Please speak slowly." · FR "Parlez lentement, s’il vous plaît." · ES "Más despacio, por favor." · HE "דבר לאט, בבקשה." — help tool — bundled in missions: 01, 02, 03, 04, 06, 07, 08, 09, 14, 15, 17, 19, 21, 22, 24, 26, 27, 29, 30
- `phrase.recovery.show-me` — EN "Can you show me?" · FR "Vous pouvez me montrer ?" · ES "¿Me lo puede mostrar?" · HE "אתה יכול להראות לי?" — help tool — bundled in missions: 04, 07, 09, 17
- `phrase.recovery.one-moment` — EN "One moment, please." · FR "Un instant, s’il vous plaît." · ES "Un momento, por favor." · HE "רגע אחד, בבקשה." — help tool — bundled in missions: 02, 03, 06, 08, 14
- `phrase.recovery.what-mean` — EN "What does that mean?" · FR "Qu’est-ce que ça veut dire ?" · ES "¿Qué significa eso?" · HE "מה זה אומר?" — help tool — bundled in missions: 16, 25
- `phrase.recovery.thank-you` — EN "Thank you!" · FR "Merci !" · ES "¡Gracias!" · HE "תודה!" — courtesy — bundled in missions: 03, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 14, 15, 17, 19, 25, 26, 29, 30
- `phrase.recovery.sorry` — EN "Sorry!" · FR "(not used by any Core mission)" · ES "(not used by any Core mission)" · HE "סליחה!" — courtesy — bundled in missions: none

Trigger: none. A tool is available only where a mission's author placed it as a button on a choice screen. Typical behaviour: the NPC repeats more slowly or more simply, then the same question is asked again without the tool button.

## Expected replies / listening items

Lead-in screen: "You said:" / "אמרת:" — EN "My name is Dan." · FR "Je m’appelle Dan." · ES "Me llamo Dan." — then "What might they answer? Learn the replies before they surprise you." / "מה הם עלולים לענות? נלמד את התשובות לפני שהן מפתיעות אותך." — button 👂 "I'm ready" / "אני מוכן".
Linked learner sentence: `phrase.social.my-name`. Each reply below is played once automatically; the learner picks its MEANING from three buttons. Distractors are always the first two OTHER replies of this same drill, in drill order (runtime rule), so the three choices are shuffled per session.

### M01-Q01 — expected-reply (step 8, reply 1 of 4)

- Prompt displayed: "What did they just say?" / "מה הוא אמר עכשיו?" (1/4)
- Audio played: EN "What's your name?" · FR "Comment vous appelez-vous ?" · ES "¿Cómo se llama?"
- Meaning of the audio (HE): "איך קוראים לך?"

- Scene `meeting-host`, c3 — `phrase.recovery.slowly` "Please speak slowly." ("דבר לאט, בבקשה.") — after NPC "Israel, wonderful! Is this your first time here?" → r3: NPC "Sure. Is this — your first time — here?" (slow) → r3 → c3b → rejoins the happy path at n4. Counts as success (recorded as "pass"); no feedback card — the dialogue simply continues.

## Wrong answer branches

- Scene `meeting-host`, c2 — after NPC "Nice to meet you, Dan! Where are you from?"

  - Feedback card: ❌ header, what you heard, your answer, what you should answer ("I'm from Israel."), "Why": "That's not what they asked — watch how they respond." / "זה לא מה ששאלו — שים לב איך הם מגיבים.". Buttons: Try again (returns to this screen) · Continue (plays the branch).
  - NPC response (r2): "Likewise! And where are you from?" — HE "גם לי! ומאיפה אתה?"
  - Then: r2 → c2b → rejoins the happy path at n3. The line "Nice recovery — the conversation continues." / "התאוששות יפה — השיחה ממשיכה." is shown on the following choice screens.

## Learning goal / intro screen

Mission card (plan metadata, shown on Home / Path / mission overview):

- Title: "Numbers & Money" / "כסף ומספרים"
- Objective: "Numbers by ear, prices, change — no more blind nodding." / "מספרים בשמיעה, מחירים, עודף — בלי להנהן סתם."
- Confidence gain: "Money makes sense. Always." / "הכסף מובן. תמיד."
- Feeling: "Nobody can confuse me with a price." / "אי אפשר לעבוד עליי במחירים."
- Estimated minutes: 20
- Situations: paying
- Declared targets: concepts 14 · phrases 3 · dialogues 1
- Listening skill (internal note, English only): price extraction at speed
- Speaking skill (internal note, English only): How-much + number answers
- Why (internal note): Numbers are the #1 comprehension task abroad; unlocks every transaction.
- Prepares next (internal note): Every payment beat in missions 3–30.

Intro screen (first Practice step; identical in the English, French and Spanish missions unless flagged):

- Icon: 💶
- Title: "Mission 2: Numbers & Money" / "משימה 2: כסף ומספרים"
- Text 1: "The most common traveler failure: you didn’t catch the price, so you just held out a big bill and hoped." / "הכישלון הכי נפוץ של מטייל: לא הבנת את המחיר, אז פשוט הושטת שטר גדול וקיווית."
- Text 2: "Today that ends. You’ll hear prices — and understand them." / "היום זה נגמר. אתה תשמע מחירים — ותבין אותם."
- Button: "Start" / "מתחילים"

## Current Practice flow

1. `talk` — intro screen — "Mission 2: Numbers & Money"
2. `prime` — before-we-speak (word intro) — 6 words → builds `phrase.money.how-much`
3. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.money.how-much` “How much is it?” · label "Ask the price" / "לשאול מחיר" (1/3)
4. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.money.by-card` “By card, please.” · label "Pay by card" / "לשלם בכרטיס" (2/3)
5. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.money.too-expensive` “That's too expensive.” · label "Polite haggle" / "מיקוח מנומס" (3/3)
6. `replies` — expected replies (listening drill) — after `phrase.money.how-much`: 4 replies
7. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You heard different prices — and caught every one." / "שמעת מחירים שונים — וזיהית כל אחד."
8. `visualMatch` — visual match (hear → tap the tile) — 5 round(s)
9. `quiz` — meaning quiz (listening) — hears `reply.money.your-change`

14. `swipe` — sentence review — 11 sentences
15. `visualMatch` — visual match (hear → tap the tile) — 1 round(s) · speed challenge
16. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "A fast decimal price — and you caught it. That’s money, under control." / "מספר עם אגורות, מהיר — ותפסת אותו. זה כסף בשליטה."
17. `summary` — victory screen

## Current Practice flow

1. `talk` — intro screen — "Mission 3: Coffee Shop"
2. `prime` — before-we-speak (word intro) — 6 words → builds `phrase.coffee.no-sugar`
3. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.coffee.iced-coffee` “I'd like an iced coffee, please.” · label "The golden template" / "משפט הזהב" (1/4)
4. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.coffee.no-sugar` “Milk, no sugar.” · label "Order control" / "שליטה בהזמנה" (2/4)
5. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.coffee.thats-all` “That's all, thanks.” · label "The universal closer" / "הסוגר האוניברסלי" (3/4)
6. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.coffee.card` “Card, please.” · label "Settling up" / "סוגרים חשבון" (4/4)
7. `replies` — expected replies (listening drill) — after `phrase.coffee.iced-coffee`: 4 replies
8. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You now recognize the four follow-ups of every barista on earth." / "אתה כבר מזהה את ארבע שאלות ההמשך של כל בריסטה בעולם."
9. `quickReply` — quick reply (hear → pick your response) — 6 round(s)
10. `sentenceBuilder` — sentence builder (put the chunks in order) — 2 round(s)
11. `dialogue` — dialogue (choose your line) — scene `breakfast-order`
12. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You ordered a full breakfast: drink, size, milk, pastry, payment. All of it." / "הזמנת ארוחת בוקר שלמה: שתייה, גודל, חלב, מאפה, תשלום. הכל."
13. `swipe` — sentence review — 14 sentences
14. `ambush` — cold open (fast line) — mode recovery · correct `phrase.recovery.repeat`, wrong `phrase.coffee.card`
15. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "An off-script surprise — and you answered with a tool. Exactly how real life works." / "הפתעה מחוץ לתסריט — והגבת עם כלי. זה בדיוק מה שקורה בעולם האמיתי."
16. `summary` — victory screen

## Before we speak / word intro

Step 2. Label: "Before we speak" / "לפני שנדבר". Intro: "The five verbs that drive every conversation. After them comes only what you want to say." / "חמשת הפעלים שמניעים כל שיחה. אחריהם בא רק מה שאתה רוצה לומר.".
The learner READS each word with its meaning always visible and may TAP it to HEAR it (TTS). Nothing is selected or scored. No internal ids exist for these words.

Words are paired across languages by their concept KEY (not by position).

1. `core.want` — EN "want" · FR "je veux" · ES "quiero" — meaning "רוצה" / "I want" — icon 🙋 — new
2. `core.need` — EN "need" · FR "j’ai besoin de" · ES "necesito" — meaning "צריך" / "I need" — icon ❗ — new
3. `core.have` — EN "have" · FR "j’ai" · ES "tengo" — meaning "יש לי" / "I have" — icon 🤲 — new

## Learning goal / intro screen

Mission card (plan metadata, shown on Home / Path / mission overview):

- Title: "Small Talk & Recommendations" / "שיחת חולין והמלצות"
- Objective: "Where from, first time here, what to try — three minutes with a stranger." / "מאיפה אתה, פעם ראשונה כאן, מה מומלץ — שלוש דקות עם זר."
- Confidence gain: "Connection, not just transactions." / "חיבור, לא רק עסקאות."
- Feeling: "I talked to someone — just because it was nice." / "דיברתי עם מישהו — סתם כי היה נעים."
- Estimated minutes: 20
- Situations: social
- Declared targets: concepts 8 · phrases 5 · dialogues 1
- Listening skill (internal note, English only): follow-up questions
- Speaking skill (internal note, English only): returning the question + asking for a recommendation
- Why (internal note): Trips are remembered by these minutes — so it comes right after arrival, not at the end.
- Prepares next (internal note): The human-conversation thread: plans, home, hobbies, past and future.

## Expected replies / listening items

Lead-in screen: "You said:" / "אמרת:" — EN "This place is beautiful." · FR "Cet endroit est magnifique." · ES "Este lugar es precioso." — then "What might they answer? Learn the replies before they surprise you." / "מה הם עלולים לענות? נלמד את התשובות לפני שהן מפתיעות אותך." — button 👂 "I'm ready" / "אני מוכן".
Linked learner sentence: `phrase.talk.beautiful-place`. Each reply below is played once automatically; the learner picks its MEANING from three buttons. Distractors are always the first two OTHER replies of this same drill, in drill order (runtime rule), so the three choices are shuffled per session.

## Learning goal / intro screen

Mission card (plan metadata, shown on Home / Path / mission overview):

- Title: "Time & Plans" / "זמן ותוכניות"
- Objective: "Today, tonight, tomorrow, later — decide what to do, and when." / "היום, הערב, מחר, אחר כך — לקבוע מה עושים ומתי."
- Confidence gain: "I make plans with people." / "אני קובע תוכניות עם אנשים."
- Feeling: "It is set. I am coming." / "קבענו. אני בא."
- Estimated minutes: 20
- Situations: social
- Declared targets: concepts 12 · phrases 8 · dialogues 1
- Listening skill (internal note, English only): times + early / late + are-you-free
- Speaking skill (internal note, English only): what-time / let-us-meet / I-am-free
- Why (internal note): Time words turn single sentences into plans; they recur in every conversation.
- Prepares next (internal note): The time frame for talking about home, the past and the future.

## Expected replies / listening items

Lead-in screen: "You said:" / "אמרת:" — EN "What time?" · FR "À quelle heure ?" · ES "¿A qué hora?" — then "What might they answer? Learn the replies before they surprise you." / "מה הם עלולים לענות? נלמד את התשובות לפני שהן מפתיעות אותך." — button 👂 "I'm ready" / "אני מוכן".
Linked learner sentence: `phrase.time.what-time`. Each reply below is played once automatically; the learner picks its MEANING from three buttons. Distractors are always the first two OTHER replies of this same drill, in drill order (runtime rule), so the three choices are shuffled per session.

## Current Practice flow

1. `talk` — intro screen — "Restaurant Meal"
2. `prime` — before-we-speak (word intro) — 5 words → builds `phrase.rest.the-bill`
3. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.rest.table-two` “A table for two, please.” · label "The opener" / "הפתיח" (1/4)
4. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.rest.ill-have-chicken` “I'll have the chicken.” · label "Order it" / "להזמין" (2/4)
5. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.rest.no-onions` “No onions, please.” · label "Special request" / "בקשה מיוחדת" (3/4)
6. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.rest.the-bill` “The bill, please.” · label "Close it out" / "לסגור" (4/4)
7. `replies` — expected replies (listening drill) — after `phrase.rest.ill-have-chicken`: 4 replies
8. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You recognize every waiter question — before it can surprise you." / "אתה מזהה את כל שאלות המלצר — לפני שהן מפתיעות אותך."
9. `quiz` — meaning quiz (listening) — hears `reply.rest.reservation`
10. `dialogue` — dialogue (choose your line) — scene `sit-down-meal`
11. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "A full dinner: from table to bill, special request included." / "ארוחת ערב שלמה: משולחן ועד חשבון, כולל בקשה מיוחדת."
12. `swipe` — sentence review — 21 sentences
13. `ambush` — cold open (fast line) — mode not set · correct `reply.rest.dessert`, wrong `reply.rest.reservation`
14. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "A long, fast sentence at the end of the meal — and you caught the point." / "משפט ארוך ומהיר בסוף הארוחה — והבנת את העיקר."
15. `summary` — victory screen

- Objective: "No onions, allergic to nuts, vegetarian — clear and safe." / "בלי בצל, אלרגי לאגוזים, צמחוני — ברור ובטוח."
- Confidence gain: "I can say what I cannot eat — and make sure the kitchen knows." / "אני יודע להגיד מה אסור לי — ולוודא שהמטבח יודע."
- Feeling: "My body is protected." / "הגוף שלי מוגן."
- Estimated minutes: 20
- Situations: restaurant
- Declared targets: concepts 9 · phrases 4 · dialogues 1
- Listening skill (internal note, English only): kitchen-check replies
- Speaking skill (internal note, English only): Without-template + allergic (timed)
- Why (internal note): RoF-3 content: rare need, catastrophic to lack.
- Prepares next (internal note): Safety phrasing for pharmacy/emergency.

Intro screen (first Practice step; identical in the English, French and Spanish missions unless flagged):

- Icon: 🥜
- Title: "Mission 15: Special Requests & Allergies" / "משימה 15: בקשות מיוחדות ואלרגיות"

## Current Practice flow

1. `talk` — intro screen — "Mission 15: Special Requests & Allergies"
2. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.diet.allergic-nuts` “I'm allergic to nuts.” · label "The line that protects" / "המשפט שמציל" (1/4)
3. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.diet.without-onions` “Without onions, please.” · label "Remove an ingredient" / "להסיר מרכיב" (2/4)
4. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.diet.vegetarian` “I'm vegetarian.” · label "Define yourself" / "להגדיר את עצמך" (3/4)
5. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.diet.does-have-dairy` “Does it have dairy?” · label "Check an ingredient" / "לבדוק מרכיב" (4/4)
6. `replies` — expected replies (listening drill) — after `phrase.diet.allergic-nuts`: 4 replies
7. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You recognize how a kitchen responds to an allergy — check, warning, and solution." / "אתה מזהה איך המטבח מגיב לאלרגיה — בדיקה, אזהרה, ופתרון."
8. `quiz` — meaning quiz (listening) — hears `reply.diet.contains-nuts`
9. `quiz` — meaning quiz (listening) — hears `reply.diet.let-me-check`
10. `dialogue` — dialogue (choose your line) — scene `allergy-order`
11. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You ordered a meal that works for you — allergy, vegetarian, no onions, ingredients checked." / "הזמנת ארוחה שמתאימה לך — אלרגיה, צמחוני, בלי בצל, בדיקת מרכיבים."
12. `swipe` — sentence review — 14 sentences
13. `ambush` — cold open (fast line) — mode not set · correct `phrase.recovery.repeat`, wrong `phrase.diet.vegetarian`
14. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "A detailed, fast safety question — and you asked them to repeat instead of guessing. With an allergy, exactly the right move." / "שאלת בטיחות מפורטת ומהירה — וביקשת שיחזרו במקום לנחש. עם אלרגיה, זה בדיוק הצעד הנכון."
15. `summary` — victory screen

Step sequence identical in EN / FR / ES: yes.

## Every sentence in this mission

Audio for every sentence: asset-first, Web Speech TTS fallback (see "Audio / speech" at the top). No highlighted/tokenised words, pronunciation data or per-sentence variants are encoded; a tip, where present, is the only explanation.

### Sentence: `phrase.diet.allergic-nuts`

- EN: I'm allergic to nuts.
- HE: אני אלרגי לאגוזים.
- FR: Je suis allergique aux noix.
- ES: Soy alérgico a los frutos secos.
- Role: learner production
- Tip / pattern note: "The life-saving template: I’m allergic to ___. Say it clearly, once, no hesitation." / "התבנית שמצילה: I’m allergic to ___. אומרים ברור, פעם אחת, בלי היסוס."
- Used in missions: 15
- Exercised here as: key sentence (step 2); "you said" lead-in of the expected-replies drill (step 6); sentence review (step 12); dialogue choice allergy-order/c1 (accepted); dialogue choice allergy-order/c1b (accepted)

### Sentence: `phrase.diet.without-onions`

- EN: Without onions, please.
- HE: בלי בצל, בבקשה.
- FR: Sans oignons, s’il vous plaît.
- ES: Sin cebolla, por favor.
- Role: learner production
- Tip / pattern note: "Template: Without ___ — removes any ingredient you don’t want." / "התבנית: Without ___ — מסירה כל מרכיב שלא בא לך."
- Used in missions: 15
- Exercised here as: key sentence (step 3); sentence review (step 12); dialogue choice allergy-order/c4 (accepted); dialogue choice allergy-order/c4b (accepted)

## Expected replies / listening items

Lead-in screen: "You said:" / "אמרת:" — EN "I'm allergic to nuts." · FR "Je suis allergique aux noix." · ES "Soy alérgico a los frutos secos." — then "What might they answer? Learn the replies before they surprise you." / "מה הם עלולים לענות? נלמד את התשובות לפני שהן מפתיעות אותך." — button 👂 "I'm ready" / "אני מוכן".
Linked learner sentence: `phrase.diet.allergic-nuts`. Each reply below is played once automatically; the learner picks its MEANING from three buttons. Distractors are always the first two OTHER replies of this same drill, in drill order (runtime rule), so the three choices are shuffled per session.

### M15-Q01 — expected-reply (step 6, reply 1 of 4)

- Prompt displayed: "What did they just say?" / "מה הוא אמר עכשיו?" (1/4)
- Audio played: EN "Let me check with the kitchen." · FR "Je vérifie avec la cuisine." · ES "Lo consulto con la cocina."
- Meaning of the audio (HE): "אבדוק עם המטבח."
- Buttons show: MEANING in the app language (Hebrew or English UI) — not the target-language text
- Choices:
  1. HE "אבדוק עם המטבח." / EN "Let me check with the kitchen." — `reply.diet.let-me-check` — ✅ accepted

- Tests: reply.diet.let-me-check

- **NPC:** Of course. I'll tell the kitchen about your allergy.

- **You:** Thank you!
  - FR: Merci ! · ES: ¡Gracias! · HE: תודה!

  - FR: Je vérifie avec eux et je reviens tout de suite. · ES: Lo compruebo con ellos y vuelvo enseguida. · HE: אבדוק איתם ואחזור מיד.

- Text 2: "Most of the work here is recognition: signs, aisles, and the self-checkout voice." / "רוב העבודה כאן היא זיהוי: שלטים, מעברים, וקול הקופה האוטומטית."
- Button: "Walk into the shop" / "להיכנס לסופר"

## Current Practice flow

1. `talk` — intro screen — "Mission 17: Supermarket"
2. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.super.where-is` “Where is the milk?” · label "Find a product" / "למצוא מוצר" (1/4)
3. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.super.do-you-have` “Do you have bread?” · label "Check stock" / "לבדוק מלאי" (2/4)
4. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.super.just-this` “Just this, thanks.” · label "At the checkout" / "בקופה" (3/4)
5. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.super.need-bag` “Could I get a bag?” · label "Ask for a bag" / "לבקש שקית" (4/4)
6. `replies` — expected replies (listening drill) — after `phrase.super.where-is`: 4 replies
7. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You recognize the answers of a shelf-stocker and a checkout — aisle, direction, weighing, bag." / "אתה מזהה תשובות של סדרן וקופה — מעבר, כיוון, שקילה, שקית."
8. `quiz` — meaning quiz (listening) — hears `reply.super.weigh-it`
9. `quiz` — meaning quiz (listening) — hears `reply.super.aisle-three`
10. `dialogue` — dialogue (choose your line) — scene `supermarket`
11. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You found products, weighed fruit, and cleared a self-checkout — on your own." / "מצאת מוצרים, שקלת פירות, ועברת קופה אוטומטית — לבד."
12. `swipe` — sentence review — 14 sentences
13. `ambush` — cold open (fast line) — mode not set · correct `phrase.recovery.show-me`, wrong `phrase.super.just-this`
14. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "The self-checkout jammed — and you knew to ask someone to show you, instead of panicking." / "הקופה האוטומטית נתקעה — וידעת לבקש שיראו לך במקום להיכנס ללחץ."
15. `summary` — victory screen

Step sequence identical in EN / FR / ES: yes.

## Expected replies / listening items

Lead-in screen: "You said:" / "אמרת:" — EN "Where is the milk?" · FR "Où est le lait ?" · ES "¿Dónde está la leche?" — then "What might they answer? Learn the replies before they surprise you." / "מה הם עלולים לענות? נלמד את התשובות לפני שהן מפתיעות אותך." — button 👂 "I'm ready" / "אני מוכן".
Linked learner sentence: `phrase.super.where-is`. Each reply below is played once automatically; the learner picks its MEANING from three buttons. Distractors are always the first two OTHER replies of this same drill, in drill order (runtime rule), so the three choices are shuffled per session.

### M17-Q01 — expected-reply (step 6, reply 1 of 4)

- Prompt displayed: "What did they just say?" / "מה הוא אמר עכשיו?" (1/4)
- Audio played: EN "It's in aisle three." · FR "C’est dans l’allée trois." · ES "Está en el pasillo tres."
- Meaning of the audio (HE): "זה במעבר שלוש."
- Buttons show: MEANING in the app language (Hebrew or English UI) — not the target-language text
- Choices:
  1. HE "זה במעבר שלוש." / EN "It's in aisle three." — `reply.super.aisle-three` — ✅ accepted
  2. HE "שם, משמאל." / EN "Over there, on the left." — `reply.super.over-there` — ❌ wrong
  3. HE "צריך לשקול קודם." / EN "You need to weigh it first." — `reply.super.weigh-it` — ❌ wrong
- Tests: reply.super.aisle-three
- Explanation shown after answering: generic: “It's in aisle three.” means “זה במעבר שלוש.”.

- Button: "Step up to the ticket desk" / "לגשת לדלפק הכרטיסים"

## Current Practice flow

1. `talk` — intro screen — "Mission 19: Public Transport"
2. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.trans.one-ticket` “One ticket to the centre, please.” · label "Buy a ticket" / "לקנות כרטיס" (1/4)
3. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.trans.which-platform` “Which platform?” · label "Find the platform" / "לאתר רציף" (2/4)
4. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.trans.does-stop` “Does this stop at the museum?” · label "Confirm the stop" / "לוודא יעד" (3/4)
5. `tool` — key sentence (listen → reveal → say aloud) — `phrase.trans.next-one` “When's the next one?” · label "Ask about the next one" / "לשאול על הבא" (4/4)
6. `replies` — expected replies (listening drill) — after `phrase.trans.one-ticket`: 4 replies
7. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You recognize the booth and platform answers — single/return, platform number, frequency." / "אתה מזהה את תשובות הדלפק והרציף — הלוך/חזור, מספר רציף, תדירות."
8. `quiz` — meaning quiz (listening) — hears `reply.trans.single-return`
9. `quiz` — meaning quiz (listening) — hears `reply.trans.every-ten`
10. `dialogue` — dialogue (choose your line) — scene `transport`
11. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "You bought a ticket, found the platform, and confirmed the train stops at your destination." / "קנית כרטיס, מצאת רציף, ווידאת שהרכבת עוצרת ביעד שלך."
12. `swipe` — sentence review — 13 sentences
13. `ambush` — cold open (fast line) — mode not set · correct `phrase.recovery.repeat`, wrong `phrase.trans.which-platform`
14. `receipt` — receipt (proof card) — "A fast disruption announcement — and you asked them to repeat instead of boarding the wrong train." / "הודעת שיבוש מהירה — וביקשת שיחזרו במקום לעלות לרכבת הלא נכונה."
15. `summary` — victory screen

Step sequence identical in EN / FR / ES: yes.

Learn the replies before they surprise you." / "מה הם עלולים לענות? נלמד את התשובות לפני שהן מפתיעות אותך." — button 👂 "I'm ready" / "אני מוכן".
Linked learner sentence: `phrase.trans.one-ticket`. Each reply below is played once automatically; the learner picks its MEANING from three buttons. Distractors are always the first two OTHER replies of this same drill, in drill order (runtime rule), so the three choices are shuffled per session.

#### Canonical happy path — Scene 1

- **NPC:** Hello! Where are you headed?
  - FR: Bonjour ! Vous allez où ? · ES: ¡Hola! ¿A dónde va? · HE: שלום! לאן אתה נוסע?
- **You:** One ticket to the centre, please.
  - FR: Un billet pour le centre, s’il vous plaît. · ES: Un billete para el centro, por favor. · HE: כרטיס אחד למרכז, בבקשה.
- **NPC:** Single or return?
  - FR: Aller simple ou aller-retour ? · ES: ¿Solo ida o ida y vuelta? · HE: הלוך או הלוך-חזור?
- **You:** Single, please.
  - FR: Aller simple, s’il vous plaît. · ES: Solo ida, por favor. · HE: הלוך, בבקשה.
- **NPC:** That's three euros. It leaves every ten minutes.

- **You:** Which platform?

## Learning goal / intro screen

Mission card (plan metadata, shown on Home / Path / mission overview):

- Title: "Past & Recent Events" / "עבר: מה עשיתי"
- Objective: "I went, I saw, I ate, I stayed, it was good — say what you did." / "הלכתי, ראיתי, אכלתי, ישנתי, היה טוב — לספר מה עשית."
- Confidence gain: "I can tell what happened." / "אני יכול לספר מה קרה."

- Estimated minutes: 20
- Situations: social
- Declared targets: concepts 8 · phrases 8 · dialogues 1
- Listening skill (internal note, English only): where-were-you / what-did-you-do / did-you-like-it
- Speaking skill (internal note, English only): five past verbs
- Why (internal note): Five past verbs answer almost every "what did you do?" a traveler is asked.
- Prepares next (internal note): The other half of the story: where you are going next.

- Icon: ⏪

## Learning goal / intro screen

Mission card (plan metadata, shown on Home / Path / mission overview):

- Title: "Future Travel & Plans" / "לאן ממשיכים: תוכניות"
- Objective: "Where I am going, for how long, what I want to do, and what comes after." / "לאן אני נוסע, לכמה זמן, מה אני רוצה לעשות, ומה אחרי זה."

- Feeling: "My trip — in my words." / "הטיול שלי — במילים שלי."
- Estimated minutes: 20
- Situations: social
- Declared targets: concepts 8 · phrases 9 · dialogues 1
- Listening skill (internal note, English only): where-next / how-long / and-after-that
- Speaking skill (internal note, English only): going-to / will-be-there / want-to / after-that
- Why (internal note): The most common question between travelers; structures over destinations.
- Prepares next (internal note): Past + future together, used in the city checkpoint.

Intro screen (first Practice step; identical in the English, French and Spanish missions unless flagged):

- Icon: 🧭
- Title: "Mission 21: Future Travel & Plans" / "משימה 21: לאן ממשיכים: תוכניות"

## Learning goal / intro screen

Mission card (plan metadata, shown on Home / Path / mission overview):

- Title: "Lost / Stolen / Police" / "אבד, נגנב, משטרה"
- Objective: "I lost, I can’t find, it was stolen, where the police are, I want to report it." / "איבדתי, לא מוצא, נגנב, איפה המשטרה, אני רוצה לדווח."
- Confidence gain: "Even when something disappears — I have a script." / "גם כשמשהו נעלם — יש לי תסריט."
- Feeling: "It is annoying, but I am handling it." / "זה מעצבן, אבל אני מטפל בזה."
- Estimated minutes: 20
- Situations: emergency
- Declared targets: concepts 8 · phrases 9 · dialogues 1
- Listening skill (internal note, English only): what-happened / where-did-you-last-see-it
- Speaking skill (internal note, English only): lost / can’t find / stolen / report
- Why (internal note): A common, stressful, non-urgent problem — kept out of the Emergency call so both stay coherent.
- Prepares next (internal note): Calm reporting, before health and emergency.

Intro screen (first Practice step; identical in the English, French and Spanish missions unless flagged):

- Icon: 🚓
- Title: "Mission 25: Lost / Stolen / Police" / "משימה 25: אבד, נגנב, משטרה"
- Text 1: "Your phone is gone. It is not an emergency — but you need to explain what happened and ask for help." / "הטלפון נעלם. זה לא חירום — אבל צריך לדעת להסביר מה קרה ולבקש עזרה."
- Text 2: "First you ask someone in the street, then you report it to the police." / "קודם שואלים מישהו ברחוב, אחר כך מדווחים במשטרה."
- Button: "Ask for help" / "לבקש עזרה"

Lead-in screen: "You said:" / "אמרת:" — EN "I have a headache." · FR "J’ai mal à la tête." · ES "Me duele la cabeza." — then "What might they answer? Learn the replies before they surprise you." / "מה הם עלולים לענות? נלמד את התשובות לפני שהן מפתיעות אותך." — button 👂 "I'm ready" / "אני מוכן".
Linked learner sentence: `phrase.pharm.headache`. Each reply below is played once automatically; the learner picks its MEANING from three buttons. Distractors are always the first two OTHER replies of this same drill, in drill order (runtime rule), so the three choices are shuffled per session.

#### Canonical happy path — Scene 1

- **NPC:** Good morning! Do you have your key?
  - FR: Bonjour ! Vous avez votre clé ? · ES: ¡Buenos días! ¿Tiene su llave? · HE: בוקר טוב! יש לך את המפתח?
- **You:** Yes, I have my key.

## Receipts (proof cards)

- Step 3: "Morning: you said what you have and asked for what you were missing." / "בוקר: אמרת מה יש לך וביקשת מה שחסר."
- Step 5: "Taxi: destination, price, stop." / "מונית: יעד, מחיר, עצירה."

- Step 9: "You ordered, got the wrong dish — and fixed it calmly." / "הזמנת, קיבלת מנה לא נכונה — ותיקנת את זה ברוגע."
- Step 11: "A chat with a traveler: where from, what you did, where next — and you disagreed, too." / "שיחה עם מטייל: מאיפה, מה עשית, לאן אתה נוסע — וגם לא הסכמת."
- Step 13: "You did not catch everything — you asked for it slowly, and you got it. That is exactly the power." / "לא הבנת הכל — ביקשת לאט, והבנת. זה בדיוק הכוח."
- Step 14: "A whole day, alone, in another language. You are ready. Actually ready." / "יום שלם, לבד, בשפה אחרת. אתה מוכן. באמת מוכן."

# Complete Existing Question Bank

Every encoded question, compact. Listening questions (expected-reply, meaning-quiz) show MEANINGS on the buttons; quick-reply, dialogue-choice and cold-open show target-language lines; visual-match shows tiles; swap-it shows slot values; mini-map shows tappable map cells; match-pairs shows the answer tiles; sentence-builder shows the chunks in their correct order. ✅ marks every accepted choice; a dialogue screen can have several.
